stimulus_id.Description: Unique identifier of the stimulus, matching the stim-<label> entity of its files.

type.Description: Type of the stimulus, matching the suffix of the stimulus file.

URL.Description: Where the stimulus can be obtained when it is not distributed with the dataset.

license.Description: License under which the stimulus file is distributed; n/a when the file is not distributed.

description.Description: Free-form description of the stimulus. Scoped catalogs in the subdirectories refine it.
